bifrost: no counterpart; closest is the AirPlay & Handoff settings page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) and the LAN TV server note (springboard/src/deildu/mod.rs:141)
summary: Apple's framework lets an app extension feed third-party media receivers into the system AirPlay-style device picker, running inside Apple's system sandbox. BifrOSt has no system device picker, no route picker view and no sandboxed discovery extension point, so nothing here has a sensible counterpart on the Linux desktop.

features.note: Apple's extension runs in a system sandbox that the picker loads when it displays. BifrOSt has no picker to load an extension into.
Device add, change and remove events are delivered to the system picker only.

features.apple: DDDevice, DDDevice.Category, DDDeviceState, DDDevice.Protocol, media playback state
features.note: Describes a receiver for the system picker icon and protocol. No shell UI consumes such a description.
Errors are reported by the Apple framework only.
The app sandbox exists, but it has no entitlement that lets an app add a receiver to a system picker.

gaps: No system device picker or route picker view that lists third-party media receivers.
No discovery extension point for receivers that an app ships with its own SDK.
AirPlay & Handoff exists only as a settings page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) with no receiver discovery behind it.
